w: "No! I could never leave you behind!"

zh: “傻妹妹，你是不是话本看多了？冷宫怎会有囚犯呢。”
w: "You read too many storybooks! They don't keep prisoners in Forlorn Palace."
Silly sister, you've been reading too many storybooks! Since when does the Forlorn Palace hold prisoners?
What is the Scholar Profession's ability?
What ability does the "Scholar" profession have?

zh: “沏香舞雩   水云间 焦尾一曲道相思 ”
w: "Dance amidst the... fragrance brew; the scorched-tail guqin plays a longing melody."
"Incense drifts as rain falls and dancers move. Amid mist and clouds, a single melody on the zither whispers of longing."
One by one, letters come bearing word to an old friend
Letter by letter, I send my word to an old friend.

zh: 一个个的 说死就死
w: One by one... dying just like that.
People are dying one after another.

zh: 一个破屋能有什么秘密
w: What secret could a rundown shack hold?
What secrets could a place like that possibly hold?

zh: 一会儿少主还要见你呢
w: The lady still wants to see you!
The young master will see you soon

zh: 一瓶女鬼魂魄制成的香料
w: A bottle. Made from a ghost girl's soul.
A bottle of incense made from a female ghost's soul

zh: 一群 丧家 之狗！
一身烂肉 你爱治不治
w: A body full of rotten flesh. Treat it or don't, I don't care.
You're covered in wounds. Treat yourself if you want.

zh: 一身酒味 寒香寻怎么教的你 还学上喝酒了
w: You reek of wine. How did Han Xiangxun teach you? Picking up drinking now?
You reek of alcohol. Just what did Han Xiangxun teach you? Turning you into a drinker.

zh: 丁乐成 勾勾 快来

w: Ten thousand leagues of campaign roads, and still they have not returned
A march of ten thousand miles, and the soldiers have yet to return.
Third Uncle? How is this possible?

zh: 三娘神志有恙 将我认作她那负心情郎
w: Sanniang's been ill. She thought I was the man who left her.
Sanniang is unwell—she mistakes me for her unfaithful lover

zh: 上次你骗我兄弟的事儿 今天就在这里清算喽
w: Last time you scammed one of ours, and today, we're going to settle the score!
Last time, you tricked my brother. Today, we're going to settle things.
Without wine, my whole body aches...
If I don't drink, everything hurts...

zh: 不好 那个黑衣人呢
w: Oh no. Where is that man in black?
No, that's not right... Uncle Jiang once taught...
No, Uncle Jiang once told me...

zh: 不是吧 难道我的心上人有了心上人
w: No way... Don't tell me the one I love already loves another?
No way... Has my love fallen for someone else?
Aren't you going to burn it?
Didn't you want it as ashes?

zh: 不是说好一起去将军祠吗
w: We were supposed to go to the General's Shrine together.
You promised we'd go to the General's Shrine!
Or I'm not talking to you.
I won't talk to you again!

zh: 不知七夕的鹊儿，会向月亮许什么愿望？
w: When the magpies bridge the sky on Qixi night, what secret do they murmur to the moon?
I wonder what wishes the magpies make on the night they build their bridge.

zh: 不知我这梦中犹自沉吟的师兄，可愿看在圣人的份上，原谅猫的主人，帮忙送她的魂回来呢？
w: Senior Brother, brooding even in your dreams, please, for the Sage's sake, forgive the cat's owner and guide her soul back.
Senior Brother, I know I shouldn't bother you while you're still half-asleep, but could you forgive the cat's owner and help bring her soul back?

zh: 不知是什么事绊住了代掌门
w: I wonder what business has detained the Acting Master...
May I ask what is keeping you

zh: 不知道自己去厨房端呐
w: Go to the kitchen and get it yourselves!
Can't you just grab it yourself from the kitchen?

zh: 不知道隔壁大伯还好吗，嘶！好痛，站不起来了。
w: I wonder if Uncle next door is alright... hiss! It hurts... I can't stand up.
How is the next-door uncle doing...? Ugh! The pain is too much. I can't even stand.
I cannot present the score in person

zh: 不要慢 我要第一个买到话本
w: Don't be slow! I want to be the first to buy a storybook!
Hurry! I'm gonna be first in line to buy it!
Leaving without even a face-to-face meeting?

zh: 不过我答应你的礼物还是会按时送的
w: but I keep my promises. I'll deliver the gift on schedule.
But the gift I promised will arrive on time

zh: 不过那把剑上刻着字 我记得是
w: However, there were characters carved on the sword. I recall it was...
I recognized the inscription on the sword, and it read...
This world doesn't work like that.
There's no such thing as "later" in this world.
What is the largest ancient ding vessel in the world?
What is the largest bronze cauldron in the world?

zh: 东阙公子说啊 若大宋取信于天下 则不出百年 纸做的钱就能通行起来
w: The Ember of East says if the Song Dynasty wins the trust of the world, paper money will circulate within a hundred years.
The Ember of East said, if Great Song earns people's trust, then within a hundred years, people everywhere will use paper currency.

zh: 临到死了留了半句话让人找
w: Leaving half a sentence at death's door for someone to find...
He left me with an unfinished sentence on his deathbed and expected me to go searching for something...

zh: 为了寒姨 我暂且跟着这恶人 有了线索再做打算
w: For Aunt Han's sake, I'll follow this villain for now. I'll decide my next move once I have a lead.
For Aunt Han's sake, I'm sticking with this villain for now. Once I get some clues, I'll decide what to do next.

zh: 为什么 为什么要一直打扰我
w: Why? Why do you keep disturbing me?
Why? Why can't you just leave me alone?
Why're you hidin' in a caravan?
Why hide in the merchant caravan?
And never farther from it either.

zh: 也好 兵来将挡水来土掩 我就拿它试试太极奇术
w: Just as well. Gotta roll with the punches. It'll be a good chance to try this newly learned Qiankun Shift!
Sounds good. Cross that bridge when you come to it. I'll take this chance to test out the Tai Chi Mystic Skill.
It didn't take anything you can carry.

zh:
乡间野酿，小酌片刻，尽兴而归。
三人倾盏，纵有江湖风雨，亦可偷闲半晌。
w:
A jug of rustic homebrew, a quiet toast among three.
Even with the storms of jianghu ever at their heels, there is still time to steal one easy, carefree moment.

A rustic brew, a quiet cup, then homeward, warm and light.
Three friends, three jars, and the storms of the road can spare a stolen night.
Hand in hand, they met each other’s tearful gaze...
The two held hands and gazed into each other's tearful eyes, and then...
Two quarters of an hour passed...

zh: 交给俺 你往巷子里跑
w: I'll cover you! Run to the alley!
Leave them to me. Run into the alley!

zh: 人不叫我活 鸟不叫我活
w: Folk want me dead, birds want me dead,
Men won't let me live, birds won't let me live.

zh: 人命关天，眼下既无他法，那我便试它一试。
w: A life hangs in the balance, and we have no other way. I suppose I can only try.
A life is on the line. If there's no other way, I'll try.
Generation after generation, life flows on without end
Generations pass in an endless, eternal cycle.
What? No, we can't do that!

zh: 什么你呀我的 嫂子最近还好 上次你背着嫂子藏的......
w: What about me? How's your wife? Last time, you kept something from her...
What are you talking about? How's your wife doing these days? That thing you hid behind her back last time...

zh: 今天又硬着头皮摘了一次
w: So I had to make it all over again.
I managed to pluck it again today

zh: 今我为木鸢 不旦可长飞数日 侦查敌情 昼夜不怠
w: Now, the eagle I've made can not only soar for days,
Now, the wooden kite I've made can not only soar for days, scouting the enemy day and night without rest,
The moon of today once cast its light upon the ancients
Yet tonight's moon once shone upon the souls of yore.
From then on, Lion Ball discovered...

zh: 他不在天泉 他之前就去了黑水城
w: He's not at Well of Heaven. He went some time ago to... Black Water City.
He's no longer in the Well of Heaven. He went to Blackwater City earlier.
What brought them to this place?

zh: 他们手里有个宝贝 我对那玩意儿好奇得紧 你帮我弄来 让我玩两天
w: They've got a treasure. I'm awfully curious about it. Go get it for me so I can play with it for a couple of days.
They have a treasure with them that I have a burning curiosity for. You help me get it and have fun for a few days.

zh: 他却说今晚自己就能到长安了
w: But the dying man said he'd make it home that night.
It was glory for him, a Tang soldier…
He was glorious as a Tang soldier!

zh: 他把种子种在了月亮里
w: So our man planted the seed on the moon.
He planted the seed on the moon

zh: 他是去让观音不哭的吗
w: So he went to stop her crying?
Did he go to stop Guanyin from crying?

zh: 他有本事去找出来自己问啊
w: If he's so capable, let him find him and ask himself!
He should find out on his own if he's that capable.

zh: 代掌门尚未继任 便已经好大的威风了
w: The Acting Master hasn't even taken office yet, but he is already throwing his weight around.
You haven't even officially taken the position yet, but you're already full of yourself, Acting Sect Master.

zh: 以下哪个门派不是游戏中的门派？
w: Which of the following is not a playable Gate in the game?
Which of these is not a sect in the game?
in hopes of easing the current financial crisis.

zh: 伊刀   是绣金楼的人
w: Yi Dao: They are from Aureate Pavilion.

zh: 伊刀 三杯吐然诺 五岳倒为轻
w: Yi Dao: A promise made over three cups outweighs all sacred mountains.
Three cups of wine seal a vow as steadfast as the weightless peaks.

zh: 伊刀 事了拂衣去 深藏身与名
w: Yi Dao: When the deed is done, one brushes off their robes and leaves, burying deeply their name and fame.
When the deed is done, I'll slip away silently, my name and presence lost to the world.

zh: 伊刀 他  来不了了
w: Yi Dao: He... he can't come.

zh: 伊刀 他不在天泉 他之前就去了黑水城
w: Yi Dao: He's not at Well of Heaven. He went some time ago to... Black Water City.
He's no longer in the Well of Heaven. He went to Blackwater City earlier.

zh: 伊刀 八月十五 带着匣子去开封 自会有人找上你
w: Yi Dao: On the 15th of the eighth month, take the box to Kaifeng. Someone will find you.
Take this box to Kaifeng on August 15. Someone will come looking for you.

zh: 伊刀 呵 纵死侠骨香 不惭世上英
w: Yi Dao: Heh. Even in death, a hero's bones remain fragrant; I feel no shame before the world's greatest.
Heh, my heroic spirit will burn bright and proud among the greatest heroes.

zh: 伊刀 哈哈哈   来啊 老子陪你玩
w: Yi Dao: Haha! Come on! I'm right here to entertain you!
Haha, come on then! I'm game!

zh: 伊刀 在没还清之前 是绝不许去死的
w: Yi Dao: Until you've paid it back, you are absolutely not allowed to die.
You must stay alive until you've paid those debts.

zh: 伊刀 小子 我没记错的话 你今年是十六了吧
w: Yi Dao: Kid. If I remember correctly, you're sixteen this year, right?
Kid, if I'm not mistaken, you're sixteen this year, right?

zh: 伊刀 我伊刀一生害人如麻 但也知道有恩必报的道理
w: Yi Dao: I, Yi Dao, have harmed countless people in my life, but even I know that debts of gratitude must be paid.
I've caused a lot of harm in my life, but I know the importance of repaying kindness.

zh: 伊刀 我回去看看 你在这老实待着
w: Yi Dao: I'm going back to check. You stay here and stay put.
I'm going back to check things out. You stay here and don't cause trouble.

zh: 伊刀 来啊 绣金楼的走狗
w: Yi Dao: Come on! Dogs of the Aureate Pavilion!
Come on, you lackeys of the Aureate Pavilion!

zh: 伊刀 绣金楼怕是来了上百人 不要对老子要求那么高
w: Yi Dao: The Aureate Pavilion has sent maybe hundreds of men. Don't set your expectations for me so high.
The Aureate Pavilion has probably sent over a hundred people. Don't expect me to handle this alone.

zh: 伊刀 谁能书阁下   白首
w: Yi Dao: Who can write of your name... until their hair turns white...
Who else but a lifelong friend could pen for you

zh: 伊刀 这是他最后交代的
w: Yi Dao: This was his final request.

zh: 伏以长恩司书神，白衣照夜守芸编。纸寿千秋君有信，积墨不辞旧时鲜。
w: O Chang'en, divine Keeper of Books, robed in white to guard the scrolls through the night. May paper endure a thousand autumns, and ancient ink never lose its light.
O Chang'en, Librarian divine; robed in white, guarding scrolls through night. A thousand years the pages remain, the ancient ink shall never wane.
Disciples: Draw our swords and strike it down.
Draw my swords and fight back.
Disciples: Give them the clothes off our backs.

zh: 会见到三次特别的月亮
w: I would see a special moon three times—
This leads to a place deep within Sorrowfield Village.
This path seems to lead deep into Sorrowfield Village.

zh: 你  你 你牛  我服了  我  跑不动了
w: You... you're too good! I yield. I... I can't run another step.
You... you're something else. I give up. I can't run anymore.

zh: 你不懂 这就好比  嗯  东阙公子那个奇术叫什么来着  画饼充饥
w: You don't understand. It's like... um... what's that Mystic Skill the Ember of East talks about? "Drawing a cake to satisfy hunger."
You don't get it. It's like the Ember of East's clever trick. What's it called? Feed on Illusions!

zh: 你不是说黑水城全城都 都死尽了么
w: Didn't you say everyone in Black Water City is... is dead?
Didn't you say the whole city was wiped out?

zh:
你与从天而降的神秘人兵刃相交 发现自己并不是他的对手 
几个过招后 他的剑刃直指你的咽喉
w:
You cross blades with the mysterious person who descended from the sky, realizing you are not his match.
After a few exchanges, his blade points directly at your throat.

You draw swords and clash with the mysterious person who descended from the sky, only to realize you're outmatched.  
After a few exchanges, his blade presses against your throat.

zh: 你个小毛孩还想抓住我 下辈子吧
w: You dare chase me, whelp? Try again in your next life!
You wanna catch me, little welp? Maybe in your next life.

zh: 你个小毛孩还想抓住我 下辈子吧！
w: You wanna catch me, little welp? Maybe in your next life.
You little brat! You think you can catch me? Try again in the next life!
are you here to try and get me to move out too?
are you here to pester me about moving out again?

zh: 你们先，你们先。老婆子我没什么可着急的。
w: Go on ahead, go on. This old woman is in no rush.
Go ahead, go ahead. I've got nowhere to be.
Tell me to wait for tomorrow?

zh: 你们想要学飞天，可知道这第一件要学的事是什么？
w: So, you want to learn to fly. Do you know what the very first step is?
Do you know the first thing you must learn about flying?

zh: 你先去等我下 我还要去小屋里看看
w: You go ahead and wait for me. I need to check the cottage first.
You wait for me. I still need to check the little hut.
Stay away! Stay away from me!
Don't come any closer! Stay back!

zh: 你到底有没有在听我说话啊
w: Were you listening to me at all?

zh: 你加入队伍，等啊等……终于轮到了你。
w: You join the queue and wait... and wait... until it's finally your turn.
You join the line. After what feels like forever, it's finally your turn.

zh: 你可推出，殿里的和尚是谁杀的？
w: Can you deduce who killed the monks in the hall?
Have you figured out who killed the monks?

zh: 你带着唐栓狗和宋桑娘来到了坟前……
w: You escort Tang Shuan'gou and Song Sangniang to the grave to confront their wayward nephew...
You brought Tang Shuangou and Song Sangniang to the grave...
You wish to enter the Jianghu?
Are you a soldier… from our side?
You are a soldier—one of ours—

zh: 你有什么办法 被两个小鬼追着要说法
w: What way? Being chased by two brats demanding answers?
What choice did you have? Those two kids were chasing you down, demanding justice.
You're here to play a Chang'an tune for us?
Will you play a tune of Chang'an?
So, you aren't truly mad after all.
You're not truly mad after all.
What's so special about this score?
What's the origin of this score you restored?

zh: 你要的菜来啦，打包拿拿好！
w: Here's the food you ordered, all packed up. Hold on to it!
Here's your order, all packed up and ready to go!
If your answer doesn't please me,

zh: 你说有急事 有什么事
w: You said there was an emergency. What is it?
You say it's urgent. What's going on?
Who says I'm trying to escape? Who's escaping?

zh: 你说那蚩尤多威风，头上长角！要是能像蚩尤一样……说不定能混成个内等子。
w: That Chi You is a mighty one with horns! If I were like him, I might make the Imperial Guard!
Chi You, with his impressive horns, is my idol! Maybe being like him will earn me a place with the Palace Guards...

zh: 你这浑身上下怎么就没点好东西
w: …But why's there nothing of worth on you?
Why don't you have anything good on you?

zh: 你醒了吗 让我看看你身体如何
w: Are you awake? Let me check on your condition.
Have you awakened? Let me see how you are doing.
Will that take me to Chang'an?
Don't worry. I've got this. Just go!
Get me this. Get me that.

zh: 像你这样的人 哪怕多救一人也会高兴的
w: Heh... I'm sure you would be happy saving even one extra person.
Someone like you would be happy to save even one more person.

zh: 先搜屋子 说不定凶手还没走远
w: Search the room! The killer may not have gone far.
Search the house thoroughly. The culprit might still be close.

zh: 入我话术研习社，更有江湖四大名嘴、话山论见榜首——唐新词唐相！亲自教你这些纵横捭阖、俎樽折冲的雄辩之道！如何，心动不心动？
w: Join the Gift of Gab Association, and Tang Xinci, one of the Four Silver Tongues and ranked first in War of Words, will personally teach you the art of winning arguments. Well? Interested?

Join our Gab Society and you can study under Tang Xinci herself, one of the Four Silver Tongues in the jianghu and the top-ranked debater in War of Words! She'll teach you how to win over a crowd, pick apart an argument, and talk your way through any crisis. So? Tempted?
Some were shut, some had fled,

zh: 典礼前事杂 耽误诸位时间
w: Matters before the ceremony are chaotic. I have wasted everyone's time.
Apologies for the delay. There were some last-minute issues before the ceremony.
it would never get closer to home.

zh: 冯大哥 我们似乎来到了一个练武场
w: Big Feng, it seems we've arrived at a training ground.
Brother Feng, looks like we've stumbled into a training ground.

zh: 况且我还没死 自己的仇 应该自己来报
w: Besides, I'm not dead yet. I should exact my own revenge.
Besides, I'm still alive. I have to settle my own revenge myself.

zh: 准备这么充分不会就为了教我轻功吧 你们本来的目标就是契丹手里的宝贝 所以那个宝贝
w: You didn't really set all this up just to teach me lightness skill, did you? Your aim all along was the treasure the Khitans were holding. So, that treasure...
You were so well prepared. Don't tell me it was just to teach me some fancy lightness skill. You were after the Khitan treasure all along, weren't you? So, that treasure...

zh: 刀架脖子了还要梗着头去
w: Blade to the neck, yet they still stick their necks out.
They still refuse to give in, even when facing death with a knife to their throats.

zh: 刘大娘 作孽哦 我只是这边买坛酒  道长 你们这个玄  啊教要如何信奉啊
w: Aunt Liu: What a sin... I just came to buy a jar of wine. Daoist Master, how exactly do I believe in this... Xuan... uh, Cult?
That's sinful talk. I was only over there buying a jar of wine. Daoist, how can I join your Xuan something cult?

zh: 刘大娘 真的吗  这天上的神仙 即将给我们聆杏村降下天罚
w: Aunt Liu: Is it true? The immortals in the sky are about to send down heavenly punishment on our Apricot Village?
Really? Are the immortals really going to send down a divine punishment on Apricot Village?

zh: 刚烙的咸食香得紧，保管您惦记着整个二来来！
w: Fresh off the iron, crisp, savory, and dangerously addictive! One bite and you'll be craving for more!
Hot off the griddle and smells like heaven! You'll be back for more, I promise!

zh: 到了，不知可否请游侠搭把手，一道将御酒搬回馆中？
w: We've arrived. Could I trouble you to lend a hand and help carry the imperial wine back to the academy?
Here we are. Would you mind lending a hand? Let's carry the wine back inside.

zh: 制香师受不了他的纠缠
w: Soon, the incense maker got tired of his questions.
The perfumer couldn't bear his pestering

zh: 前人之物 今人称主 笑话
w: An object of the ancients, claimed by the living? What a joke.
Calling something yours just because you found it? What a joke.

zh: 前辈又说笑 总觉得这件事不太简单 您不会坑我吧
w: You're joking again, Senior. I get the feeling this isn't simple. You wouldn't be setting me up, would you?
You're joking, right? Something tells me this isn't as simple as you say. You're not trying to trick me, are you?
Cut them down, left and right

zh: 千夜 呵 不过将死之躯
w: Qianye: Heh. Nothing but a dying body.

zh: 千夜 哦~（盯着瞧）仔细瞧 小哥哥/小妹妹长得真俏
w: Qianye: Oh! (Stares intently) Now that I look closely... you're quite the looker, little brother/sister.
Oh. (eyes me closely) Look at that, you're quite the handsome young man/pretty young lady.

zh: 千夜 就是不知道这挺翘的鼻子 有没有闻到江湖人的味道呢 是个臭男人的味道哦
w: Qianye: I just wonder if that perky little nose of yours has ever caught the scent of a Swordsman? It's the stench of a filthy man.
I wonder if that sharp little nose of yours can pick up the scent of the wanderer, like a smelly man's scent.

zh: 千夜 终于肯出来了是吗
w: Qianye: Finally willing to show yourself?
So you've finally decided to show up, huh?

zh: 千夜 （摇一摇酒杯）这么好的酒要是来年喝不到了 真是可惜呢
w: Qianye: (Swirls the wine cup) It would be a real pity if I couldn't drink such fine wine next year.
(swirling the wine) Such fine wine. If I can't enjoy it this time next year, that'd be a real shame.

zh: 千夜 （看向我）哦 最牵挂的人 那小哥/妹妹你说说 恨也算牵挂吗
w: Qianye: (Looks at me) Oh? The person I miss most? Tell me, little brother/sister... does hatred count as caring?
(looking at me) Oh? The one who truly holds your heart? Tell me, sir/lady, does hatred count?

zh: 千夜 （闻了闻杯中酒）眷言一杯酒 悽怆起离忧 这就是离人泪吗
w: Qianye: (Sniffs the wine in the cup)Not words of love nor wine's relief can stay the sting of parting's grief. So this is... Parting Tears?

On his way back to Chang'an

and be free from illness and fear!

If the moon brings you joy, I'll pluck it for you

Behold the refined gentleman: cut and filed like bone, carved and polished like jade.

Good wine, good friend— who needs anything else?

The day will come when your unfinished revenge is settled.

They were all killed. There's nothing left to talk about.

A beam of white light shot down from the sky out of nowhere, fires broke out everywhere, and many people died.

w: Scholar Li: Stop immediately! Don't anger the immortals. Zhang Village over by Mount Taihang was struck by heavenly punishment earlier.
Enough! Don't anger the immortal. Zhangjia Village near Mount Taihang was struck by divine punishment not long ago.

zh: 李秀才 村长 此乃天道 不可语 不可语

Village Chief, this is the will of heaven, which is beyond our understanding or words.

Well, I'm not leaving. I'm just not.

This person moves through the Well of Heaven like there is no one to impede them. Clearly, their strength is no joke.

zh: 死也不敢死 活也不敢活
w: Too afraid to die, too afraid to live.
Neither daring to die nor daring to live.

Even at the end, I still managed to outsmart you, Master...

In the imperial examination's palace test, what is the second-place winner called?

People come first, the state second, the ruler last.

You really know how to bring trouble to yourself.

w: Jiang Yan: Heh. Aren't you afraid Moonstream will become a target for all?
Haha, aren't you worried Moonstream will become the target of everyone's criticism?

People say I'm an usurper who committed patricide.

I've never heard that Moonstream is known for good wine.

w: Jiang Yan: Take this child with you.

My long illness will soon claim me, beyond even heaven's saving. Yet three questions still puzzle me.

w: Bandits took my pack in the morning

Lantern spirit, lantern light. Report what you know, if you might. All under the sun, is within your sight.

Lanterns! Shiny lanterns! A must-have for night walks. Transform bad luck into good fortune!

Grandpa, are they really giving out money today?

I'm just returning something to its rightful owner. How is that breaking in?

Xuanyuan Cult... Darn it. They must be hiding something...

All living things are bound by the decrees of the Seven Luminaries. Those who are ignorant cannot escape divine punishment.

Heaven's way is fixed, and fate is unchangeable, but by embracing the teachings of the Xuanyuan Cult, there remains hope for redemption.

Humans arise from the earth, which shifts with the seasons, while heaven moves in endless cycles from the primal source. This primal essence dwells within all things, and true faith means living in harmony with it.

This is the true universal harmony.

Amidst the bamboo groves and blooming seas of flowers, the wind is gently held and energy quietly gathers.

Old Shi, you're only now asking? I've already rewritten a bunch of copies.

A broken mirror reunited, spilled water gathered

At its limit, things change; with change, they flow; flowing, they endure.

Now that the flute's fixed, there's no point dwelling on the past.

Banquet red, river black. Every guest passed out. No turning back.

Here, these are the Fuping persimmons I mentioned in my letter. Try one, it'll quench your thirst!

zh: 英雄何须显，燕影自逍遥。
w: Heroes need not show, the swallow freely flows.
you're always making trouble for me,
It is not to be, Brother!

zh: 行当管理员 入我悬壶者 当不惧艰险 昼夜 寒暑 饥渴 疲劳 济世救人 不惜吾身
w: Profession Administrator: Those who enter my Healers' Union must not fear hardship, day or night, cold or heat, hunger or fatigue. Save lives without regard for one's own body.
Those who serve here must be unafraid of hardship. Day or night, rain or shine, hunger or thirst, fatigue, your mission is to heal and save lives, no matter the cost.

zh: 行当管理员 入我悬壶者 当不问疾厄者贵贱贫富 长幼亲疏 一而视之
w: Profession Administrator: Those who enter my Healers' Union must treat all patients equally, regardless of noble or poor, young or old, close or distant.
Here, it doesn't matter who you are, rich or poor, old or young, friend or stranger, you'll be treated with equal care.

zh: 行当管理员 入我悬壶者 当常怀大慈恻隐之心 誓愿普救含灵之苦
w: Profession Administrator: Those who enter my Healers' Union must always harbor great compassion and vow to save all living beings from suffering.
Anyone who joins our Healers' Union must carry a heart full of compassion and vow to ease the suffering of all living beings.

zh: 行当管理员 少侠 你可能做到
w: Profession Administrator: Young Wanderer, can you do this?
Young Hero, do you have what it takes to uphold this?
It just appears lively and bustling,

zh: 褚清泉既然让我来找你 绝不是胡乱指的
w: Since Chu Qingquan sent me to you, it wasn't a random guess.
Chu Qingquan wouldn't have sent me to you for no reason.

zh: 要我说，带他们几个去鬼市子走一圈，把他们吓破胆，肯定乖乖听话！
w: If you ask, take them for a stroll through the Ghostlight Market. Scare the wits out of them, and they'll behave!
I say we drag them through the Ghostlight Market. One lap in there and they'll do whatever we say!

zh: 要是我十分警惕 没被他偷去东西呢
w: What if I was super alert and didn't let him steal from me?
What if I'd been more careful and hadn't let him steal from me?

zh: 让我们一起祝无痕公子
w: Let's all wish Young Master Wuheng

zh: 让诸位长老 执剑使枯等一刻有余啊
w: ...leaving the Elders and Sword Enforcers waiting for over a quarter of an hour.
From making us wait here for so long?

zh: 记住 #N房顶#E和#N屋檐#E都是好地方
w: Remember #Nthe roof#E and #Nthe eaves#E are good spots.
Remember, #Nrooftops#E and #Neaves#E are both great spots.
Then let us put it to the test!
Alright, let's see what you've got.

zh: 该我们血祭祸首 以告亡者 以示决心
w: It is time we sacrificed the ringleader in blood, to honor the dead and prove our resolve!
it's our turn to avenge the dead and to show our resolve—with blood, if we have to.
Here you go! Serves you right!
Speak! What is the meaning of this?

zh: 说什么傻话 你回来
w: What are you saying? Come back here!

zh: 诶 等等  薛前辈 这次造成的混乱您打算如何处置
w: Hold on, Elder Xue. What do you intend to do about the chaos caused here?
Hold on. Elder Xue, what're you going to do about the mess we caused?

zh: 诶 说好的一起闯荡江湖
w: Hey, we promised to roam the Jianghu together.
You promised we'd roam the world together...
Hey! You better hurry up and follow me!

zh: 诶。要是等会朱大人喝茶，没了盖子，就是小老儿招待不周了。
w: Ah... If Lord Zhu comes for tea and the lid is gone, it'll be my poor hospitality to blame.
If Lord Zhu goes to drink his tea and there's no lid, I'll look like a terrible host.
Who wants to give it a try?

zh: 诸位乡邻，君子不强人所难，还请莫要勉强这位游侠。游侠高义，此事凭君自断。
w: Everyone, a true gentleman does not force others against their will, so please do not pressure this wanderer. They are reasonable enough to make their own decision.
Good neighbors, please don't pressure the Wanderer. Such a righteous soul should be allowed to decide freely.

zh: 诸位长老正在议事 不可进入天地堂
w: The Elders are deliberating. You cannot enter the Heaven and Earth Hall.
The elders are in a meeting right now, so the Heaven and Earth Hall is off-limits.
No one was trying to hit you.
Let whoever wants to find it, find it.
Who says I won't save you?

zh: 谢家当年陷害风不遇的事 也该到真相大白的一天了吧
w: The truth about how your family framed Feng Buyu all those years ago must finally come to light.
It is time for the truth of the Xie family's betrayal of Feng Buyu... to come out.

zh: 谢家待你不薄 你为何要装疯陷害
w: Our family treated you well. Why feign madness to frame us?
The Xie family treated you well. Why pretend to be crazy and set others up?

zh: 质胜文则野，文胜质则史。文质彬彬，然后君子。
w: When nature exceeds refinement, one is rude; when refinement exceeds nature, one is pedantic. Only when nature and refinement are well balanced can one be a gentleman.
Substance without style is crude; style without substance, hollow. Only in balance lies the true gentleman.
and silver starts flowing like water...
You got a batch of silver rewards

zh: 走了 抓的活口够多了 不差这两个
w: Let's move. We've captured enough alive. We don't need these two.
Let's move. We've caught enough live targets already. A couple more won't matter.
I left in too much of a hurry and twisted my foot.
Walked too fast and twisted my ankle.

zh: 跑不动了啊 我之前怎么说的 “等我追上你 一定打爆你狗头 ”姑奶奶我说到做到
w: Can't run another step? What did I say before? "When I catch you, I’m smashing your head in." And I always keep my word.
Give up? Didn’t I say, “When I catch you, I’m smashing your head in”? I mean that!

zh: 跑不动了啊 我之前怎么说的 “等我追上你 一定打爆你狗头 ”小爷我说到做到
w: Can't run another step? What did I say before? "When I catch you, I’m smashing your head in." And I always keep my word.
Give up? Didn’t I say, “When I catch you, I’m smashing your head in”? I mean that!
Go on! Why'd you stop running?
Run! Why are you just standing there?

zh: 辞多则史，少则不达。辞苟足以达，义之至也。
w: If language is too verbose, it becomes superficial; if too sparse, it fails to convey the meaning. If language is just enough to convey the meaning, it reaches the perfection of expression.
Too many words bring pedantry; too few fail to convey. To speak just enough is the peak of elegance.
Go to the kiln and look into it!
Well? Run along to the kiln and look into it!

zh: 还占着地儿对着你那谱子和歌练舞
w: practice space for that score of yours.
Occupying space, practicing dances with your score and songs
Some even turned to robbing us…

zh: 还能干 我还能干  财神爷
w: I can still do it. I still can... God of Fortune...
I've still got it. I'm still sharp! The God of Fortune!

zh: 还能怎么办 再抄呗 我昨夜默了一整晚呢
w: What else can I do? Copy it again. I spent the whole night reciting it from memory.
What else? I'll just copy it again. I spent all last night memorizing it.

zh: 还说他是他们要找的命定之人
w: Said he was the one they'd been looking for.
They said he was the chosen one they sought

zh: 这 钱 大历十五年的
w: This coin… it's marked the fifteenth year of Dali.
No one waits around for anyone

zh: 这个石惊天，遇见了什么麻烦，怎么也不在信里说清楚。
w: What trouble did this Shi Jingtian run into? He didn't even explain clearly in the letter.
Shi Jingtian... what mess did you step in? Why so cagey?

zh: 这个香料的味道好得很
这么些天 走了这么些天……
w: All these days… we kept on traveling…
So many days, so far walked...
This score has just been restored

zh: 这些人好奇怪  怎么看不到我似的
w: This is strange... Why don't they seem to notice me?
These people are acting so strange. It's like they don't even see me.

zh: 这位司驴，我能请你帮我个忙吗？
w: Excuse me, Donkey Master. Could you help me with something?
Excuse me, could you do me a favor?
All Tang folk are long gone!
There are no Tang people left here!

zh: 这可是满江红 你就喝一口 一口能醉吗
w: Come on, it's River All Red. One sip won't knock you down!
This is "River All Red Wine". Just take a sip. You won't get drunk from just one sip, right?
That way, your parents can rest assured.
That's how you put their hearts at ease.

zh: 这轻功看起来可真俊俏 再加把劲
w: That Lightness Skill looks truly elegant. Keep it up.
Your lightness skill is impressive. Keep it up.
How can such a place exist?
Is there such a place here

zh: 连这位青溪小友也未能解吗？敝人幸得一位故交，乃当世圣手，眼下只得修书一封求助于他。然此际千里迢迢，但恐远水难解近渴……
w: So even your Silver Needle skills are of no use here? Luckily, I have an old friend who's said to be a divine healer. I can only try to send him a letter. But the road between us is long, and I fear his help may come too late…
Even our young friend from Silver Needle couldn't do anything about it? I know a healer of rare skill. I can write to him at once, but he's a long way off. Help may not come in time...

zh: 连这老天爷也不让我活啊！
w: and even Heaven wants me dead!
Even the heavens won't let me live!
And may it be many years yet
We're going our separate ways anyway.
When a Daoist dreams of donkeys...

zh: 那 那我现在也没办法回去了
w: Well... I can't go back now anyway.
Then... I guess there's no way for me to go back now.

zh: 那个 你刚才戴的是这顶帽子吗
w: Um, were you wearing this hat just now?
Hey, was that the same hat you had on just now?
Now that those people have shown up,

zh: 那人不得已与他们同住一处
w: He stayed with them. Had no choice.
That man had no choice but to stay with them
Then why doesn't he come in person?
The female ghost let out a wretched cry

zh: 那位观音不想在月亮里
w: She didn't want to be there.
That Guanyin didn't want to stay in the moon

zh: 那你救啊 我们 还有你的亲人
w: Then help us! Us... and your own kin!
Then do it! Think about us, and your own family too.

zh: 那你是流放过来的汉家人？
那倒没有 武林录上写您是抗辽义士 深孚众望
w: Not at all. The Wulin Journal says you are an anti-Khitan warrior, deeply trusted by the people.
The Wulin Journal describes you as a warrior. One deeply respected by all.

zh: 那制香师身周散发着令人神醉的异香
w: She was surrounded by this intoxicating scent.
The perfumer exuded an intoxicating fragrance

zh: 那地方离长安还有千万里
w: They were still so far from Chang'an.
The place was still thousands of miles away

zh: 那天我遇见了一个了不得的神仙
w: There, I met a most remarkable immortal.
That day I met an extraordinary immortal

zh: 那它到底是西域的琵琶
w: So was it a pipa from the west?
Is it a Western Regions pipa
But I can't just leave you behind!
Let me show you how it works.
And by then, I would have three chances

zh: 那是我这辈子能见到的
w: that would be the fullest moon
That dancing horse is clearly not right.
Something was clearly off about that horse dancer.

zh: 酒……有酒吗……快给我喝一口……
w: Wine... Is there any wine? Hurry, let me have a sip...
Wine... got any wine? Just one sip...

zh: 钓竿、钓竿！急死我了！曹门大街咋这么远，我几时才能买到我的宝贝钓竿！
w: My fish rod! This is killing me! Why's Caomen Avenue so far away? When will I get my hands on my precious rod!
That rod, that rod! Caomen Avenue feels a hundred li away! When will I ever get there?!

zh: 铜能当钱 铁也能当钱 那么是不是
w: Copper can be money, iron can be money. Then maybe...
Iron could work just as well, right? Then...

zh: 长安？长安早就不管这儿了！
w: Chang'an? Chang'an abandoned this place long ago!
Chang'an? Chang'an gave up here long ago!

zh: 长安？长安早就管不着这儿了！
w: Chang'an? Chang'an abandoned this place long ago!
Chang'an? Chang'an hasn't ruled here for ages!

zh: 间人心硬 用毒常求无解
w: A spy's heart is hard; their poisons are meant to have no cure.
Spies are ruthless, always searching for the deadliest poisons.

zh: 阁下还在天空飞速挪移呢
w: Your Excellency is still moving rapidly through the sky.
Sir, you're still darting through the sky like the wind.

zh: 阿蔚 带少侠去住所休息
w: Wei, take the Young Wanderer to their quarters to rest.
A'wei, take the young hero to his room for a rest.
A hundred miles along the Longxi road...
Over two hundred miles from Longxi

zh: 陈子奚 伤你 哪有喝酒有趣
w: Chen Zixi: Harming you? How is that as fun as drinking?
Me? Isn't drinking way more fun?

zh: 陈子奚 可惜来的匆忙 没带什么好酒 再有几日 水月先生亲手酿的一斛春就要成了 不如跟我去尝一尝
w: Chen Zixi: It's a pity I came in a rush and didn't bring any good wine. In a few days, the "Sliver of Spring" wine brewed by Master Moonstream himself will be ready. Why not come with me to taste it?
Unfortunately, I came in a rush and didn't bring any fine wine. But Master Moonstream's self-made Spring Wine will be ready in just a few days. Why don't you come with me and give it a try?

zh: 陈子奚 天下人是天下人 陈子奚是陈子奚 我有眼有耳 他们的话算什么
w: Chen Zixi: The world is the world; Chen Zixi is Chen Zixi. I have my own eyes and ears. What do their words matter?
Let them say what they want. I'm Chen Zixi. I see and hear for myself. Their gossip means nothing to me.

zh: 陈子奚 我从江南到燕北 从幽云到雁回山 好不容易见到老朋友 难道不值得喝上一杯
w: Chen Zixi: I traveled from Jiangnan to Yan Northern Vow, from Yanyun to Mount Yanhui. I finally see an old friend; isn't that worth a drink?
I've traveled all the way from Jiangnan to Yanbei, from Youyun to Yanhui Mountain. It's not every day I get to see old friends. Surely that calls for a drink.

zh: 陈子奚 我倒要看看 水月请人喝酒 谁敢来找麻烦
w: Chen Zixi: I'd like to see who dares cause trouble when Moonstream invites a guest for a drink.
I want to see who'd dare stir up trouble at Moonstream's banquet.

zh: 陈子奚 这下有趣了 你选哪边
w: Chen Zixi: Now this is interesting. Which side do you choose?
Now things are getting interesting. Which side will you pick?

zh: 陈子奚 这孩子又是怎么回事
w: Chen Zixi: What is the story with this child?
What's the matter with this kid?
From which work do Feng, Ya, and Song originate?
Where do the terms "Feng," "Ya," and "Song" come from?

zh: 风不遇偷学刀法被门规处置 是咎由自取
w: Feng Buyu stole blade techniques and was punished according to sect rules. He brought it upon himself.
Feng Buyu was punished for stealing sword techniques. He has only himself to blame.

zh: 魏老奶一个漂移，刹住身势，用膝盖稳稳地停在你身边。
w: Granny Wei pulls off a sharp drift, braking smoothly to drop to one knee right beside you.
Granny Wei skids to a stop right beside you, steady as a rock.

zh: （内有小献首客）互相推搡 你  你去 你去
w: (Junior Headsman insde) Pushing each other... You go! You go!
(Inside, headsman) Shoving and jostling. You—you go. Go!

zh: （被打）哎呦  嘿嘿  （被打）哎呦  来 来 小娃娃们 一块唱  月儿升 月儿沉
w: (Getting hit) Ouch! Hehe... (Getting hit) Ouch! Come, come, little kids. Sing along... The moon will rise, the moon will set...
(Being hit) Ow!—haha—Ow! (Being hit) Come on, kids! Let's sing together: The moon will rise, and the moon will set.

zh: （这小丫头怎么变得这么忧郁  ）
w: (Why does this girl look so sad all of a sudden?)
(How did this little girl get so gloomy?)
